headline: AMTD IDEA Group in Advanced Talks to Acquire Third New York City Hotel
summary: AMTD IDEA Group announced it is in advanced dialogue to acquire a third hotel in New York City, following its earlier acquisition of the Hilton Garden Inn in Tribeca.
why: Hospitality asset acquisitions by investment groups alter their real estate portfolio concentrations and income-generating asset bases.

impacts.name: AMTD IDEA Group
impacts.why: Potential hotel acquisition expands the group's U.S. hospitality real estate footprint.
